races.paceDynamic: Hammer The Hammer will lead unchallenged early, setting a sustainable gallop that suits his front-running style. Behind him, nine horses want prominent positions creating a congested pack including Jakajaro, Bergerac, Sturlasson, Luna A Inbhir Nis, and Heavenly Heather - this will cause interference and traffic problems approaching the final 2f. The hold-up brigade including Redorange, Toca Madera, Air Force One and Corolla Point will need luck in running from their back positions. This pace dynamic strongly favours front runners and those who can secure early prominent positions without getting trapped in the midfield scrum.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Hammer The Hammer gets his own way in front and the prominent pack gets snarled up behind
scenarios.body: The leader kicks clear while the congested chasers interfere with each other, leaving insufficient time for hold-up horses to make ground. Sustainable early pace becomes winning pace when tactical chaos unfolds behind.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Escapes Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If one of the early prominent horses avoids the traffic and gets first run on the leader
scenarios.body: The winner emerges from the pack just before it bunches, getting clear racing room while others remain trapped behind faltering horses. Clean passage proves decisive in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Times Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack completely stalls 2f out creating gaps for back markers
scenarios.body: Patient tactics pay dividends as the early pace collapses and hold-up horses find racing room through tiring leaders. Strong finishing kicks from deep positions decide the outcome.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Hammer The Hammer goes too fast early and the field comes back to him quickly
scenarios.body: The entire field compresses into one group turning for home, creating a cavalry charge finish where any horse with tactical speed can prevail. Jockey strength becomes crucial in the melee.

Redorange and Air Force One need significant pace collapse to get competitive from hold-up positions in 22-runner field
Hammer The Hammer's 3lb claiming allowance reduces his weight to effective 135lbs making front-running task easier
Several horses returning from lengthy breaks including Redorange (235 days) and Luna A Inbhir Nis (237 days) may need run
Multiple Tim Easterby runners Copper Knight and I'm Next both showing good recent 5f form at lower levels

races.paceDynamic: Point Lynas stands alone as the only confirmed front runner in this 19-runner field, which creates a perfect scenario for him to dictate terms from the front without early pressure. The prominent runners Mirsky, Point Of Contact, Old Cock, Croupier and First Principle will sit behind him but none are aggressive pace-forcers. This sets up a moderate gallop through the early stages before the large field of hold-up horses including Vafortino, Sea Force, Diego Ventura and Thunder Roar fan out for their challenges in the final three furlongs. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce sustained finishing kicks from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Point Lynas sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays moderate through halfway
scenarios.body: The large field of closers get perfect cover and can unleash their finishing speed in a cavalry charge finish. Quality hold-up performers like Vafortino, Sea Force and Diego Ventura can pick off the front runner in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Point Lynas gets soft fractions and kicks clear approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: His stamina and lack of early pace pressure allows him to maintain his advantage despite the wall of finishers. The hold-up horses close ground but can't quite reel him in under his light weight.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners positions perfectly behind Point Lynas and strikes at the right moment
scenarios.body: Mirsky or First Principle get the best of both worlds with a good position and the ability to respond when the hold-up horses make their moves. They avoid traffic problems that could hinder the back markers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Point Lynas goes too slow early and gets swamped by the prominent runners taking over
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint finish where positioning and luck matter more than ability. This chaotic scenario could favour any horse avoiding trouble rather than following form.

watchPoints.text: Point Lynas could get uncontested fractions and prove hard to peg back despite his layoff
Traffic problems likely in straight with 19 runners and many hold-up horses needing room
Mirsky's prominent style could be perfectly positioned if positioned behind the leader
Sea Force and Vafortino both need the pace to develop to showcase their finishing kicks
First Principle has strong all-weather form but needs to prove effectiveness on turf

races.paceDynamic: Fallen Angel will look to establish an uncontested lead from the start, with Red Letter and Diamond Rain likely to race prominently behind her but not apply early pressure. The lack of natural pace means Fallen Angel can dictate comfortable fractions through the early stages, while hold-up horses See The Fire and Fairy Glen (if declared) will settle towards the rear. This controlled tempo will allow the pace-setters to stay competitive deep into the race, but the finishing kick of the hold-up horses becomes potent if they can get a clear run. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the steady pace and kick, with hold-up horses needing everything to fall right.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Fallen Angel sets uncontested fractions and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: The leaders maintain their advantage as the kick comes late, with prominent runners having first jump on the hold-up horses. Red Letter and Diamond Rain benefit most from this tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too slow and bunches the field turning for home
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup as Fallen Angel's fractions prove unsustainable in a sprint finish. See The Fire's superior class rating tells under Oisin Murphy's patient ride.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Fallen Angel's 208-day break hasn't dulled her speed and no one challenges early
scenarios.body: James Doyle lets Fallen Angel use her natural pace advantage to build an unassailable lead that holds under pressure. Her four Group wins at this trip show the template.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Red Letter or Diamond Rain unexpectedly press Fallen Angel from the start
scenarios.body: The early battle compromises all the pace angles, creating a messy finish where any horse getting a clean run can prevail. Form and class become secondary to racing luck.

Monitor Fallen Angel's early pace judgment after 208 days off - if she goes too fast early she'll be vulnerable late
See The Fire needs the pace to develop properly; if it's too steady he may have too much ground to make up

races.paceDynamic: Item and Guildmaster will both go forward from the gates, with Item likely to cross and lead given his superior early speed despite the long layoff. The duo will set a solid tempo over this staying trip, with Action, Al Zanati, Christmas Day and Morshdi forming the prominent group behind. The even gallop will stretch the field in the straight, allowing the patient tactics of Wise Prince and King's Trail to come into play. This honest tempo favours hold-up horses who can produce sustained finishing kicks over prominent runners who may get drawn into pace pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses profit
scenarios.trigger: If Item and Guildmaster maintain honest fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The even gallop will set up perfectly for closers to unleash finishing kicks, with the prominent runners feeling the pinch in the final two furlongs. Wise Prince and King's Trail are best positioned to capitalize with their patient tactics and superior finishing speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent trackers prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes moderate with Item settling
scenarios.body: The reduced tempo will allow Action, Christmas Day and Morshdi to travel easily in behind before quickening clear of the leaders. Their combination of tactical speed and proven class will prove decisive over the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runners dominate
scenarios.trigger: If both Item and Guildmaster show improved stamina
scenarios.body: The leaders will string out the field with relentless galloping, preventing any meaningful challenge from behind. Item's class edge and race fitness advantage over Guildmaster will prove crucial in a staying test.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical pace collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Item fails to fire after his long break
scenarios.body: Guildmaster will inherit an uncontested lead and dictate pedestrian fractions throughout the race. The slow tempo will result in a sprint finish where Action and Christmas Day can utilize their superior tactical speed.

watchPoints.text: Item's fitness after 226 days off - if he fails to show early speed, the entire pace scenario collapses

Action and Christmas Day getting too keen behind the leaders - could compromise their finishing kicks
Wise Prince's position turning in - needs clear room to unleash his finishing speed from the rear

races.paceDynamic: Revival Power and Simplify will ensure a strong early gallop with both natural front-runners likely to dispute the lead from the gates. Revival Power has shown consistent pace-setting ability with three wins from the front, while Simplify has won twice leading and will press hard under McDonald. This honest tempo will create a searching test over the minimum trip, with prominent racers like Aspect Island and Boston Dan tracking close behind. The sustained pace favours horses with proven finishing kicks from hold-up positions, particularly those who can produce their best work in the final furlong when the early leaders tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Revival Power and Simplify go too fast early and both fade in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The dual front-runners will set unsustainable fractions that play into the hands of hold-up horses with proven finishing speed. Manatee Mehmas and Dickensian possess the tactical speed and class to capitalise when the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but sustainable, allowing stalkers to position perfectly
scenarios.body: Aspect Island and Boston Dan can track the leaders without overexerting and have the class to strike when racing begins in earnest. Their prominent running styles are perfectly suited to this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Revival Power or Simplify get easy sectionals and kick clear turning for home
scenarios.body: One of the leaders will get more conservative fractions than expected and use superior fitness to dominate. Revival Power's three wins from the front suggest he can dictate terms effectively.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Hold-up Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is moderate and the race becomes a sprint finish from the back
scenarios.body: Black Star Boy or Temple Of Athena could benefit from a tactical affair that develops into a dash. Their recent form suggests they possess the speed for a quick finish.

watchPoints.text: Revival Power and Simplify could set suicidal early pace that compromises both their chances completely
Dickensian making seasonal debut after 244 days off for Kevin Ryan who can be slow to get them fully wound up
Aspect Island has been slightly disappointing since winning maiden, needs to show Listed class improvement
Manatee Mehmas switching to Tudhope suggests connections very confident about his current condition
Temple Of Athena and Wor Faayth both represent Brian Ellison who has no winners in 16 runners recently

races.paceDynamic: Northern Brave, Hard To Believe and Parisian Scholar will ensure a strong gallop from the outset, with all three possessing leading tendencies and the tactical incentive to take this race by the scruff of the neck. The sustained pace over 1m4f will put serious stamina questions to the field, particularly as the tempo is unlikely to relent with three genuine front-runners engaged. This searching gallop will set up the race perfectly for the hold-up horses to deliver their challenges late. The race shape strongly favours closers who can pick up the pieces when the pace-setters capitulate in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners go too fast early and tie each other up
scenarios.body: The strong pace will stretch the field and create the perfect scenario for closers to sweep past tired leaders in the final furlong. Baltic Fleet, Cotton Bud and Stoneacre Donny possess the tactical speed and stamina to capitalise when the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-runner survives strong pace
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters can dictate terms and kick clear turning in
scenarios.body: Hard To Believe or Northern Brave could use their class to establish a decisive advantage while their main pace rivals weaken, holding on despite the sustained effort. The winner would need to be tough enough to resist the late surge of closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent runners strike late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but not suicidal, allowing prominent racers to stay in touch
scenarios.body: Sudbury Hill and Pendella can track the leaders without over-exerting early, then use their finishing kick to strike when the front-runners begin to fade. Their tactical positioning gives them the perfect launching pad for a late assault.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If all three front-runners go off too conservatively and bunch the field up
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint finish where any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of early positioning. This would nullify the tactical advantages and turn it into a lottery finish where any of the field could prevail.

watchPoints.text: Northern Brave has been off for 217 days and may need the run despite his natural front-running style
Hard To Believe could steal a march if the other pace-setters are slow to engage and let him dominate early
Baltic Fleet's trainer George Boughey has a decent strike rate and this horse should relish the strong pace
Parisian Scholar raced just 7 days ago which could leave him vulnerable against fresher opponents
Cotton Bud drops significantly in class after his recent maiden win and could be well handicapped
